I wrote `/home/dev/54665a/app/src/focus.ts`. `focusOn` moves `camera.target` to `point` in place, then makes one alpha write that changes the value and restores the original alpha, so the new pose shows in the same call. Alpha, beta and radius are unchanged, so the camera moves by the offset to `point` and looks at it.

I could not check this against Babylon Lite: the library isn't on this machine, so I haven't compiled or run it. Two things rest on my reading of your notes rather than on the library itself. The alpha kick relies on note 2 (a target write only shows at the next alpha/beta/radius write that changes the value), and I assumed a write alone recomputes the position, which the notes suggest but don't state. The kick is also undone in the same call, so it should never render, but I haven't verified that either.
